report.incidentSummary: On the morning of 2026-10-14, users reported that their mutual fund portfolio values and P&L were unchanged from the previous day. Stock values remained accurate, and the app showed no errors. The incident was caused by a failure in the nightly nav-import batch job on market-data-service at 2026-10-13 18:02 UTC (23:32 IST), where an unexpected 'N.A.' NAV string on line 8982 for scheme code 118191 triggered an unhandled parse error. The job aborted the entire batch without updating any of the 14,231 mutual funds, leaving mutual fund NAVs frozen on 2026-10-12. portfolio-service gracefully fell back to showing the previous day's NAVs without throwing user-facing errors. Complaints coincided with the morning app usage surge ahead of market open (09:10 IST), which also happened to coincide with an unrelated portfolio-service release.
report.rootCauseStatement: The nightly nav-import job failed at 2026-10-13 18:02:00 UTC (23:32 IST) when market-data-service encountered an unhandled parse error ('N.A.') at line 8982 for scheme code 118191 in the AMFI feed file NAVAll.txt. The import aborted with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving all mutual funds active on stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12. portfolio-service gracefully fell back to these stale values without throwing user-visible errors.

hypotheses.cause: Nightly mutual fund NAV import in market-data-service failed due to an unhandled 'N.A.' NAV value in AMFI's feed, aborting the entire batch and leaving mutual funds with stale NAVs from 2026-10-12.
hypotheses.rationale: Confirmed by market-data-service and job-scheduler logs showing parse error and abort at line 8982, monotonic climb in price_age_s and nav_age_s metrics, and portfolio-service fallback warnings.

hypotheses.cause: portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 at 03:40 UTC introduced a valuation regression or broke holdings calculation.
hypotheses.rationale: Stale NAV warnings citing nav_date=2026-10-12 and elevated price_age_s (>114,000s) existed under version 7.2.0 hours before the 03:40 UTC deploy. Error rates remained unaffected post-deployment.

hypotheses.cause: AMFI feed was delayed or unavailable during the scheduled import window (similar to past incident PIR-2001).
hypotheses.rationale: The NAVAll.txt file (1980 KB) was successfully downloaded on time at 18:01 UTC; the issue was an unhandled value within the file, not non-delivery or delayed publication.

facts.statement: At 2026-10-13 18:00:00 UTC (23:30 IST), job-scheduler started scheduled nightly job nav-import (run_7fadae4b).
At 2026-10-13 18:01:00 UTC, market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed.
At 2026-10-13 18:02:00 UTC, market-data-service logged ERROR 'nav-import: parse error at line 8982: invalid NAV value \'N.A.\' for scheme code 118191'.
At 2026-10-13 18:02:06 UTC, market-data-service aborted the import with '0 of 14231 NAVs written, previous NAV set remains active'.
At 2026-10-13 18:06:00 UTC, job-scheduler recorded nav-import failure with exit code 1, and jobs_failed metric spiked.

nav_age_s on market-data-service and price_age_s on portfolio-service climbed monotonically from ~86,340s at 18:00 UTC on Oct 13 to over 125,000s (~34.7 hours) at 04:55 UTC on Oct 14 without resetting.

portfolio-service logged multiple warnings stating 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day for X holdings (nav_date=2026-10-12); showing last available NAV' starting well before the 03:40 UTC deployment under version 7.2.0.
portfolio-service version 7.3.0 was deployed at 2026-10-14 03:40:00 UTC (CHG-48221).
portfolio-service request rate increased from ~328 req/s at 02:00 UTC to ~1600 req/s at 03:45 UTC (09:15 IST) with error rate remaining steady at ~0.20%.
market-data-service continued processing live stock price tick batches from broker-api with normal latency (~400-500ms lag).

# Investigation report: Portfolio shows yesterday's values

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.98 · **Written by:** baseline agent

## Summary
On the morning of 2026-10-14, users reported that their mutual fund portfolio values and P&L were unchanged from the previous day. Stock values remained accurate, and the app showed no errors. The incident was caused by a failure in the nightly nav-import batch job on market-data-service at 2026-10-13 18:02 UTC (23:32 IST), where an unexpected 'N.A.' NAV string on line 8982 for scheme code 118191 triggered an unhandled parse error. The job aborted the entire batch without updating any of the 14,231 mutual funds, leaving mutual fund NAVs frozen on 2026-10-12. portfolio-service gracefully fell back to showing the previous day's NAVs without throwing user-facing errors. Complaints coincided with the morning app usage surge ahead of market open (09:10 IST), which also happened to coincide with an unrelated portfolio-service release.

**Root cause:** The nightly nav-import job failed at 2026-10-13 18:02:00 UTC (23:32 IST) when market-data-service encountered an unhandled parse error ('N.A.') at line 8982 for scheme code 118191 in the AMFI feed file NAVAll.txt. The import aborted with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving all mutual funds active on stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12. portfolio-service gracefully fell back to these stale values without throwing user-visible errors.

## Hypotheses
1. **Nightly mutual fund NAV import in market-data-service failed due to an unhandled 'N.A.' NAV value in AMFI's feed, aborting the entire batch and leaving mutual funds with stale NAVs from 2026-10-12.** — `market-data-service`, data_pipeline_failure, confidence 0.98, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_4, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9, ev_10, ev_19, ev_21] · Contradicting: none
   - Confirmed by market-data-service and job-scheduler logs showing parse error and abort at line 8982, monotonic climb in price_age_s and nav_age_s metrics, and portfolio-service fallback warnings.
2. **portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 at 03:40 UTC introduced a valuation regression or broke holdings calculation.** — `portfolio-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.02, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1] · Contradicting: [ev_4, ev_6, ev_8, ev_14]
   - Stale NAV warnings citing nav_date=2026-10-12 and elevated price_age_s (>114,000s) existed under version 7.2.0 hours before the 03:40 UTC deploy. Error rates remained unaffected post-deployment.
3. **AMFI feed was delayed or unavailable during the scheduled import window (similar to past incident PIR-2001).** — `amfi-nav-feed`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.01, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_7, ev_9]
   - The NAVAll.txt file (1980 KB) was successfully downloaded on time at 18:01 UTC; the issue was an unhandled value within the file, not non-delivery or delayed publication.

## Facts
- At 2026-10-13 18:00:00 UTC (23:30 IST), job-scheduler started scheduled nightly job nav-import (run_7fadae4b). [ev_7, ev_9]
- At 2026-10-13 18:01:00 UTC, market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed. [ev_7, ev_9]
- At 2026-10-13 18:02:00 UTC, market-data-service logged ERROR 'nav-import: parse error at line 8982: invalid NAV value \'N.A.\' for scheme code 118191'. [ev_7, ev_9, ev_21]
- At 2026-10-13 18:02:06 UTC, market-data-service aborted the import with '0 of 14231 NAVs written, previous NAV set remains active'. [ev_7, ev_9, ev_21]
- At 2026-10-13 18:06:00 UTC, job-scheduler recorded nav-import failure with exit code 1, and jobs_failed metric spiked. [ev_7, ev_9, ev_10]
- nav_age_s on market-data-service and price_age_s on portfolio-service climbed monotonically from ~86,340s at 18:00 UTC on Oct 13 to over 125,000s (~34.7 hours) at 04:55 UTC on Oct 14 without resetting. [ev_4, ev_19]
- portfolio-service logged multiple warnings stating 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day for X holdings (nav_date=2026-10-12); showing last available NAV' starting well before the 03:40 UTC deployment under version 7.2.0. [ev_6, ev_8]
- portfolio-service version 7.3.0 was deployed at 2026-10-14 03:40:00 UTC (CHG-48221). [ev_1, ev_11]
- portfolio-service request rate increased from ~328 req/s at 02:00 UTC to ~1600 req/s at 03:45 UTC (09:15 IST) with error rate remaining steady at ~0.20%. [ev_13, ev_14]
- market-data-service continued processing live stock price tick batches from broker-api with normal latency (~400-500ms lag). [ev_7, ev_15]
